title: dennstaedtia hirsuta f. cristata
intro: Dennstaedtia hirsuta f. cristata, commonly known as the hair-stalked or hairy maiden's hair fern, is a type of plant belonging to the Dennstaedtiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dennstaedtia hirsuta f. cristata include being anti-edematous and anti-allergic, making it useful for treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
